subject: Gelatinous Cube
picture: A giant jelly cube fills a dungeon corridor wall to wall. Draw the cube as a big rounded square outline. Inside the jelly, a helmet, a bone, and a coin pouch float at different heights. Add a few large bubble circles inside the cube. The items do not sit on the floor. Stone corridor, ceiling, walls, large floor slabs, closed far door. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02.
